purpose: Invitee side of the invitation flow on the library: the pending view over invitations.pending() (the only pending store), the deny layer (blocked sponsors), the 256/8 caps with silent declines, and native accept/decline. S8 added the invite side; S10/S11 add the invite context.

public_api.name: createDenyLayer
public_api.description: Seam DenyLayer. isBlocked(pubkey) = lib/blockedPeers isBlockedPeer over the loader's CURRENT set (read per call, no cache). Throws TypeError at construction when the loader is missing.

public_api.name: DenyLayer.isBlocked
public_api.description: Consumed by the pending view (S9) and by S10 (invite context) / S12 (join request) which drop a blocked sender before storing anything.

public_api.name: applyPendingCaps
public_api.signature: <T extends {id; sponsorAccount; receivedAt}>(list: readonly T[], limits?: {total; perInviter}) => { retained: T[]; excess: T[] }
public_api.description: Pure. Oldest first (receivedAt, then id); a later arrival never displaces a retained one. Defaults are PENDING_TOTAL_CAP / PENDING_PER_INVITER_CAP.

public_api.name: PENDING_TOTAL_CAP / PENDING_PER_INVITER_CAP
public_api.description: Re-exports of GLOBAL_CAP / PER_INVITER_CAP of lib/pendingInvitations.ts (AC-CAP-1: equal by construction).

public_api.name: createPendingInvitationView
public_api.signature: (deps: { invitations: {pending, decline}; denyLayer: DenyLayer; enqueue: (job) => void; onError?: (e) => void }) => PendingInvitationView
public_api.description: Seam PendingInvitationView. pending(): PendingInvitation[] (synchronous snapshot, oldest first, copy); onChange(cb) => unsubscribe; plus onArrival(cb) (bell source, only for newly visible, never on first load), onInboxDisposition(d) (frame-safe: only enqueues a refresh), refresh() (outside frames), scheduleRefresh(), isVisible(id), dispose(). Blocked sponsors: decline(id,{declineRumor:false}); excess over caps: decline(id,{declineRumor:false}); neither is ever shown.

public_api.name: createInvitationActions
public_api.signature: (deps: { invitations: {pending, decline, accept}; view: {refresh, isVisible}; attachGroup: (g) => void; onError? }) => { accept(id): Promise<MarmotGroup>; decline(id): Promise<void> }
public_api.description: accept(id) re-reads the list, refuses (InvitationActionError 'unknown-invitation') an id the view hides, calls invitations.accept, attaches the group, refreshes. decline(id) calls invitations.decline(id,{declineRumor:true}) (the native decline rumor, no kind 21063), then refreshes.

dependencies_allowed: client (ClientJobQueue.enqueue passed in by injection, no import)
dependencies_forbidden: localStorage lp_pendingInvitations_v1 and every function of the old pending store
client/ construction (the MarmotClient slice is injected)
keyPackages.offer / invitations.expectWelcome (D8: S12 owns the single auto-accept path)
external_ports: invitations.pending() (library, account scope: only from a queued job or UI handler)
events_consumed: inboxDisposition (client listener; kinds pending / joined / already-member / branch-switched trigger a queued refresh)
